description: This file defines the interface JsonFieldSelectorBuilder, a mutable builder with a fluent API for constructing JsonFieldSelector objects, including methods for adding, removing, and parsing JSON pointers and field definitions.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelectorBuilder
classes.description: An interface for a mutable builder with a fluent API to construct JsonFieldSelector objects, supporting addition and removal of JSON pointers, string representations, field definitions, and parsing from selector strings.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds one or more JSON pointers to the builder.

methods.name: addPointers
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointers from an iterable.

methods.name: addPointerString
methods.description: Adds JSON pointers from string representations.

methods.name: addPointerStrings
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointer strings from an iterable.

methods.name: addFieldDefinition
methods.description: Adds JSON pointers from given field definitions.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Parses and adds pointers from a field selector string with options.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Parses and adds pointers from a field selector string with default options.

methods.name: removePointerString
methods.description: Removes a pointer by its string representation.

methods.name: removePointerStrings
methods.description: Removes multiple pointers by their string representations.

methods.name: removeFieldDefinition
methods.description: Removes a pointer associated with a specific field definition.

methods.name: removeFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Removes multiple pointers associated with given field definitions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector containing all added pointers.
